pcieSlotWatts.source: PCI Express Card Electromechanical (CEM) Specification: a x16 graphics slot supplies at most 75 W; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PCI_Express#Power

ambientC.source: approx. game-design estimate: June garage ambient temperature

failPerGpuDay.source: docs/research/02-datacenter.md §10.1 (Llama 3: 4.7e-4 interruptions/GPU/day) x3 game design for a garage

throttleFactor.source: approx. game-design simplification of Pascal throttling

boom.source: approx. game-design estimate: 2017-2018 crypto-mining boom GPU rental; applies through boomEndIso (2018-03-31) inclusive, the 1 $/day rate starts 2018-04-01T00:00Z

after.source: approx. game-design estimate: GPU rental after the boom

raiseUsd.source: Game-design scaling of docs/research/03-economy.md §10.3 (stage 1: $2–5M @ $15–25M) down to a 2017 garage lab

preMoneyUsd.source: Game-design scaling of docs/research/03-economy.md §10.3 (stage 1: $2–5M @ $15–25M) down to a 2017 garage lab

dilution.source: Game-design scaling of docs/research/03-economy.md §10.3 (stage 1: $2–5M @ $15–25M) down to a 2017 garage lab; 1.5 / (8 + 1.5)

baseC.source: Game-design estimate: idle GPU temperature in a garage tower with 25 C ambient

perLoadC.source: Game-design estimate: temperature rise of a stock-cooler Pascal GPU from idle to 100 % load

neighbourTowerC.source: Game-design estimate: extra degrees per neighbouring GPU sharing a closed tower case

neighbourOpenFrameC.source: Game-design estimate: open-air frame, 1.5 C per neighbour so 3 cards settle just under the throttle point

smoothing.source: Game-design estimate: fraction of the gap to the target temperature closed each hour

recoverBelowC.source: Game-design estimate: a GPU shut down by overheating restarts at full performance once it cools below the throttle temperature

seedMinCustomers.source: Game-design choice: customers needed before a seed investor shows up

seedMinReputation.source: Game-design choice: reputation needed before a seed investor shows up

seedReofferWeeks.source: Game-design choice: weeks after declining before the seed round can be offered again

weekRealMs.source: Game-design estimate: at x1 one game week (168 h) lasts 40 s of real time

maxTickMs.source: Game-design estimate: real ms per tick are clamped so a throttled or resumed tab never catches up lost time
